notes: Machine-readable activist firm registry. Human mirror: short_activist_registry.md and activist_press_ingest.md. ingest_methods supports sec_13d, site_index, press_wire, manual. Legacy ingest_method kept for compatibility. `region` is advisory (us/jp/kr/hk/eu): firms outside the US mostly file with their home regulator, so sec_13d only catches them when they cross into a US-listed name.
